subject: Intro + quick recap — procurement, budget owner & SOC2
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <apark@echohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + quick recap — procurement, budget owner & SOC2

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the 30-minute call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency under 150ms p50, < $0.002/token target, on-premise data deletion controls, and SSO/SAML for service accounts.
- Likely economic buyer: Samir Vyas (VP Data) — you said you'd confirm and introduce.
- Procurement flow: procurement portal + PO (preferred) — Leah Chong is the procurement contact you mentioned.
- Security ask: EchoHealth requires SOC 2 Type II and audit logs; we'll surface our SOC 2 report and an onramp checklist.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm Samir as the economic buyer and Leah as procurement contact (and best emails)?
2) We will send a short Mutual Action Plan and SOC2 access link for Leah/IT to review.
3) Proposed intro call with procurement + IT security next week (30 min) — we're available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Attachments: redwood-evalpack.pdf (overview), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)

If you prefer a PO, let us know standard terms/lead time and any vendor setup forms.

Thanks — looking forward to introductions.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-evalpack.pdf (PDF overview, 1.2MB)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel, outline)

Thanks, Grace.

Confirming the following:
- Econ buyer: Samir Vyas (samir.vyas@echohealth.com) — I will loop him in this thread tomorrow.
- Procurement: Leah Chong (leah.chong@echohealth.com) — she handles vendor onboarding and PO setup.
- Security: I'll put Leah in touch with Mateo (IT security lead) for SOC 2 intake; they typically want the report + brief on data residency controls.

A couple of notes on timeline:
- Procurement prefers vendor paperwork completed within 2–3 weeks for pilots under $50k.
- Any SLA or custom contract will add another 2 weeks (legal review).

I'm fine with Tue/Wed AM PT — add a calendar hold once you confirm availability.

Alicia

Hi Alicia (and Samir/Leah) —

Thanks for confirming Alicia — Samir and Leah, great to e-meet you. Per Alicia's notes, we will:
- Share SOC 2 Type II link and a concise onboarding checklist for procurement/IT.
- Send over the Mutual Action Plan with milestone dates for pilot kickoff and success criteria (latency/cost/QA checks).
- In parallel, we'll prepare a procurement pack (vendor form, COI, standard T&Cs). Ben, can you prep the pack and the SOC 2 link? Priyom, will add the onboarding checklist.

Proposed meeting: Tue 9/7 10:30–11:00 PT — quick intro (procurement + security). If that works I'll send an invite.

Question for procurement: do you prefer a standard PO for the pilot or a short SOW with Redwood's master services terms? Either works for us but want to align on preferred workflow.

Attachments: procurement-onramp.txt (vendor intake checklist)

Best,
Grace

Grace —

Thanks for loop. Quick pricing/contract note before the procurement call:
- For pilot under $50k recommend pricing band: $30k flat for 6-week pilot (includes support & monitoring). If they push for lower, we can consider up to 15% discount but need approval.
- I'll assemble the vendor pack: COI, SOC2 link, W-9, standard MSA (redlines accepted only by legal).
- If procurement asks about SLA credits, pass to me and I'll escalate to sales ops; our standard pilot doesn't include credits.

I'll upload the pack to the shared drive and DM you the link.

Ben
